old: but today I had pop choir rehearsals, which is run by my French teacher.
new: but today I had a pop choir rehearsal; the choir is run by my French teacher.
reason: Relative 'which is run' cannot refer to plural 'rehearsals'; Italian 'che è diretto' refers to the choir

old: At boarding school, on the other hand, I have only been living for three years, but by now
new: On the other hand, I have only been living at boarding school for three years, but by now

old: At tennis I play with Sam, a boy from my boarding house
new: I play tennis with Sam, a boy from my boarding house
reason: Unnatural English 'At tennis I play with'

old: Every morning we used to ski all together, and in the afternoon
new: Every morning we all skied together, and in the afternoon
reason: 'used to' is wrong for a single week's holiday (Italian imperfect of repeated action within the week)

old: we had to go by our room to get the history book
new: we had to stop off in our rooms to get our history books
reason: Unnatural English 'go by our room'; boys have single rooms
